name: T. J. Kerr
role: Book-keeper, later traveling auditor, N. P. Refrigerator Car Co.
bio: T. J. "Tommy" Kerr arrived at Medora in February 1884 to keep the books for the Marquis de Mores' Northern Pacific Refrigerator Car Company, and signed the Republican convention call that April. In May 1884 he was promoted to traveling auditor, in charge of the books of all the company's cold-storage houses, with his headquarters at Medora; the work kept him traveling between St. Paul and Helena. The paper praised his piano playing and his good humor, and in June 1885 it described his summer home on White Bear lake.
